content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya often face restrictions when using Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad for processing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s. As a result, they're forced to look for alternative solutions that can help them process payments and deliver digital products to their customers. What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting platform that allows developers to automate tasks, workflows, and applications. In the context of digital commerce, it can be used to create custom scripts that automate order processing, payment verification, and product delivery. By using Google Apps Script, digital creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that's not dependent on third-party payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This means they can process payments and deliver products to their customers without any restrictions or fees associated with these platforms. Additionally, Google Apps Script provides a secure and scalable solution for automating digital commerce workflows, making it an attractive option for creators who want to take control of their online business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds, thanks to Google Apps Script's ability to automate tasks and workflows. When a customer makes a payment, the script triggers a webhook that sends a notification to the creator's backend logic. This logic then verifies the payment and sends a confirmation to the customer. Meanwhile, the script automatically generates a download link for the product and sends it to the customer via email. This seamless process ensures that customers receive their digital products quickly and efficiently, without any manual intervention required. By automating these tasks, Google Apps Script saves creators time and reduces the risk of human error, making it an essential tool for digital commerce.

The Components That Make It Work Together

A Google Apps Script-based sovereign stack typically consists of a few key components: Google Apps Script itself, a Cloudflare Pages website or GitHub Pages, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, and a Supabase or Google Sheets database for storing orders. When a customer makes a payment, the script triggers a webhook that sends a notification to the creator's backend logic. This logic then verifies the payment and sends a confirmation to the customer. Meanwhile, the script automatically generates a download link for the product and sends it to the customer via email. By integrating these components, creators can build a seamless digital commerce workflow that automates order processing, payment verification, and product delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a Google Apps Script-based sovereign stack today, follow these steps: First, sign up for a Cloudflare account and create a new website on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, create a Google Apps Script script that automates order processing and payment verification. Then, integrate this script with a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend to verify payments and send confirmations to customers. Finally, set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store orders and automatically generate download links for products. By following these steps and leveraging the power of Google Apps Script, digital creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that's not dependent on third-party payment platforms.
